var cartImage = rt.AssetImage{
		SheetW: SheetW, SheetH: SheetH, SpriteCols: SpriteCols, SpriteRows: SpriteRows, SpriteN: SpriteN,
		MapW: MapW, MapH: MapH, MapLayers: MapLayers, MapPlaneMask: MapPlaneMask, MapStreaming: MapStreaming, SheetReadOnly: SheetReadOnly, Sheet: sheetROM[:], Map: mapROM[:], Flags: flagROM[:],
		PoseIndex: poseIndexROM[:], PoseParts: posePartROM[:],
		PoseVariantBaseCount: 0, PoseVariantNames: poseVariantNamesROM,
		AnimationClips: animationClipROM[:], AnimationFrames: animationFrameROM[:],
		SheetIndex: sheetIndexROM[:],
}
func main() {
	rt.DebugLog("Cartridge preview started")
	cartData.SheetW, cartData.SheetH = SheetW, SheetH
	cartData.SpriteCols, cartData.SpriteRows, cartData.SpriteN = SpriteCols, SpriteRows, SpriteN
	cartData.MapW, cartData.MapH, cartData.MapLayers, cartData.MapPlaneMask = MapW, MapH, MapLayers, MapPlaneMask
	cartData.MapStreaming, cartData.SheetReadOnly = MapStreaming, SheetReadOnly
	cartData.Sheet = sheetRAM[:]
	cartData.SheetIndex = sheetIndexRAM[:]
	cartData.Map, cartData.Flags = mapRAM[:], flagRAM[:]
	cartData.PoseIndex, cartData.PoseParts = poseIndexROM[:], posePartROM[:]
	cartData.PoseVariantBaseCount, cartData.PoseVariantNames = 0, poseVariantNamesROM
	cartData.AnimationClips, cartData.AnimationFrames = animationClipROM[:], animationFrameROM[:]
	if !ctx.Init(&cartImage, &cartData) { rt.DebugLog("Cartridge assets could not be initialized. Rebuild the project."); for {} }
	ctx.InitHardware()
	ctx.SetProfiling(true)
	if !pcmAudioController.Init(pcmBankROM[:],pcmMusicIDs[:],pcmSampleIDs[:]) { rt.DebugLog("Imported audio could not start. Run mtile import-audio and rebuild."); for {} }
	ctx.AttachPCMAudio(&pcmAudioController)
	game.Init(&ctx)
	// _init runs while Mode 0 is force-blanked; commit its
	// spritesheet mutations before the first visible frame.
	ctx.FinalizeInitHardware()
	for {
		// One iteration = exactly two display frames (about 30 Hz).
		// The LCD always scans at 59.73 Hz;
		// each rendered image is shown for two whole scans. PaceFrame30
		// waits on LCD events with HALT after update/draw, so
		// the flip always lands in the second frame's VBlank - a fast
		// iteration can never flip one frame early and alternate cadence.
		ctx.BeginFramePace()
		ctx.PollInput()
		ctx.PollPauseMenu()
		paused := ctx.PauseActive()
		if !paused {
		ctx.BeginProfilePhase(rt.ProfileUpdate)
		game.Update(&ctx)
		ctx.EndProfilePhase(rt.ProfileUpdate)
		ctx.BeginProfilePhase(rt.ProfileDraw)
		ctx.BeginRenderFrame()
		game.Draw(&ctx)
		ctx.EndProfilePhase(rt.ProfileDraw)
		// Finish renderer work off screen: Mode 4 already drew on the hidden
		// page, so nothing tears, and update+draw own the full two-frame
		// window (~562k cycles) minus only the flip itself.
		ctx.PrepareRender()
		}
		if paused { ctx.PreparePauseMenu() }
		ctx.PaceFrame30()
		ctx.WaitForPresentWindow()
		if paused { ctx.PresentPauseMenu() } else { ctx.PresentRender() }
		heaplessStats := ctx.DebugSnapshot()
		heaplessStats.HeapCapacity, heaplessStats.HeapHandleLimit = 0, 0
		debugMailbox.Begin(heaplessStats)
		debugMailbox.Add("ticks", rt.NumVal(game.ticks))
		debugMailbox.End()
		ctx.EndFramePace30()
		ctx.WaitVDraw()
	}
}
